title: ReLoop
tagline: Reserve surplus and count only confirmed handovers.
inspiration: A surplus listing is not the same as a completed reuse. ReLoop separates offers, reservations and donor-confirmed handovers.
whatItDoes: Lists usable materials, atomically reserves available units and lets only the donor confirm each handover once. The impact view counts confirmed, self-declared mass.
howItWasBuilt: Next.js provides the listing and claim workflow. PostgreSQL performs bounded stock updates and confirmation checks, with signed workspaces, ownership controls and same-origin protection.
technicalEvidence: Local automated verification is included in this repository. Real provider calls, cloud deployment and browser end-to-end verification remain pending.
authorship: Prepared with ChatGPT/Codex assistance. Shared Next.js/workspace infrastructure originates in code-up-matrix/axios-fx-compliance-agent; the product module was developed on 27 October 2026. Shared code must be disclosed under the event’s reuse rules.
eligibility: Overview says students only. Rethinking Waste: impact 35%, technology 25%, feasibility 20%, demonstration 20%. Public repo and two-to-three-minute video.
judgeAccessInstructions: Provide the private judging access code through the submission portal after live verification. Do not put it in public source.
challenges: Concurrent claims must not oversell inventory or inflate the impact ledger. The integration tests exercise contention and donor-only confirmation against PostgreSQL.
accomplishments: Six standalone tests and the production build pass. No real-world waste reduction or emissions savings have been measured.
lessons: An impact metric should reflect the event it actually measures. Confirmed declared mass is more defensible than treating every listing as a diversion from landfill.
next: Resolve the event's student eligibility requirement, deploy with a dedicated database and conduct a small consented reuse trial before making outcome claims.
judgeFit: Maps to Rethinking Waste: confirmed reuse for impact, atomic reservation for technology, a small local exchange for feasibility and a two-workspace demonstration. Student eligibility remains a submission hold.
demo: List a clearly labeled synthetic surplus item.
Reserve units from a second workspace.
Show that an excessive or competing claim cannot oversell.
Confirm once as the donor and inspect the confirmed-mass ledger.
